name: QiYi Clock
reviews: Cách giải khác hẳn cube, thú vị
description: The QiYi 3x3 Clock (Magnetic) is a speedcubing-ready magnetic clock puzzle designed for smooth, accurate solves. A twelve-tooth magnetic edge wheel snaps each increment precisely into place, while a dial-bottom magnetic ring system keeps transitions between lifted and pressed states stable and predictable.
